item.title: Diesel price increased, petrol rate kept unchanged
item.description: The price of high-speed diesel has been increased by Rs3 per litre while the petrol rate remains unchanged for the next fortnight.

item.title: Pakistan announce squad for home Test series
item.description: Pakistan announced their squad for the home Test series, with three uncapped players and two senior pacers rested for the first match in Rawalpindi.
